This is a fantastical tale of an exotic land. The Old Empire has fallen, leaving rival tribes to fight for control of the great desert. Little do they know of the seeds of darkness which grow in the shadows with each passing day... Sands of Salzaar is an open-world strategy-action RPG set across a sprawling desert. Build up and manage your forces from a single unit to a mighty army, then lead them into massive battles against your foes. 人類！我是Bob，來自《人類跌落夢境（Human: Fall Flat）》裏的一名“沒有骨氣”的軟體怪。 《人類跌落夢境（Human: Fall Flat）》有著多樣的物理交互規則，鬼畜是妳的奧義，妳甚至可以躺在地上全身電臀抖動，與自己的隊友們手拉手闖關，享受被隊友坑害，推下懸崖，或是被當做炮彈發射的整個過程。遊戲依然是一次購買，沒有其他收費服務。更重要的是，沙雕的併不只有Bob一個，多達八人好友一起陪妳，還可以隨時隨地邀請他們一起降智，在聯機中互相葬送各自的友誼。 在手機上玩玩家自制的內容？Bob不止一種面孔，既是火影忍者，還要兼職外賣，曾經西裝革履，現在專職海盜。手機上會不斷更新PC創意工坊中的優秀內容，讓妳和妳的朋友們有更多搞怪故事發生！ -沙雕玩法，鬼畜新世界，物理碰撞出的沙雕結果，遠在妳想象之外。 -優化了動作操作，低上手門檻使妳做出許多觸手怪才能做出的動作。 -八人聯機的規模讓智商呈8倍降落，根本擋不住，好友互關語音--邀請讓友誼聯繫起來更方便。 -持續搬運&移植更新創意工坊玩家自製沙雕內容。 -遊戲界面現在更簡潔好看了，只為襯托妳的沙雕之旅。

应用描述

Rassel – Pocket Shaker transforms your iPhone to a shaken percussion instrument. Just pick up the device and shake it. This initial version comes with four different instruments: Egg, Shaker, Tambourine and Bells. Just swipe the screen to change between them. Unlike similar apps, Rassel is based on a unique audio rendering engine that accounts for continuous velocity changes based on how the sampled instruments are agitated. The device’s gyroscope is directly mapped to this velocity which makes any movement sound the way a real instrument would. We’ve tried to fine-tune the app to be as lifelike as possible, both in sound and handling response. We think we got pretty close. Features: - Instruments: Egg, Shaker, Tambourine and Bells - Choose between loose, normal or tight setting - Loudness boost option
